budget_rule: floor(f * U_d), f in [.25,.50,.75]; U_d=distinct feature payloads in complete primary provisional pool; minimum 1; same budgets across methods
quality_constraints: Primary provisional eligibility; complete original labeled payload; no repeated feature payload. Minority quota first, capped by available distinct minority feature payloads. Weighted class-balanced TRAIN-region coverage, then fewer near neighbors, larger separation, smaller uncalibrated concern, source order.
coverage_reference: Distinct TRAIN (feature values, literal class) regions; uniform regions for C, equal total weight per represented literal TRAIN class for D; also report row-weighted and unique-feature coverage
minority_rule: Least frequent literal TRAIN class; lexicographic token tie-break; no target-semantic inference
controls: B2-accepted INTERSECT primary provisional pool, source-order at same budgets; B1/B3 intersections identical to primary and reported without redundant runs
sensitivities: quality-coverage on frozen combined-review-q80 and combined-review-q95 pools, primary middle budget only; no admission changes
tie_break: Deterministic source occurrence order, then occurrence ID; greedy numeric keys rounded to 12 decimals
stopping: Stop at exact requested budget or explicit eligible/distinct-feature exhaustion; no zero-gain early stop; record shortfall
declaration: Predeclared before coverage/diversity outcome inspection. Exploratory geometric design; no utility, risk, validity or novelty guarantee.
